newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 18.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 18.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The parliament is discussing an amendment to the compensation law, with the aim of giving compensation to the relatives of those who became victims of state autocracy without court judgment.
- The probability of a strike in university education has weakened.
- Farmers think the national agricultural programme does not tackle current problems.
- The police have difficulties in coping with the large amount of Extasy tablets in circulation.
- Property registrations will be fully computerised.
- The Catholic church and the civil organisations organise a joint conference with the motto "To live without fear".
